Task T048 (Refactor metrics.py for single-sample t-test) is placed in Phase 7 (Revision), but it corrects a fundamental statistical logic error (FR-005 vs Plan) that affects the core evaluation logic of User Story 2. If T048 is not completed before T024 (Implementation of metrics.py) or T025 (Null Hypothesis Protocol), the implementation will be based on the wrong statistical test (paired vs single-sample). T024 is in Phase 4, T048 is in Phase 7. This creates a 'consumer before producer' scenario where the evaluation logic (T024) is implemented before the correction (T048) is defined, leading to a broken artifact that requires re-work. T048 should be a prerequisite to T024/T025.
